shared_elements: standing anthropomorphic figure carved in the round (monolithic statue)
frontal rigid pose with arms held against the torso
hands/arms brought to the chest or abdomen holding objects
flat-topped head with schematic facial features
incised low-relief motifs on the body/torso
columnar block-like body with no separated legs
justification: Both depict a frontal, columnar anthropomorphic monolith with a flat-topped schematic head, an undivided block body, and arms folded across the torso holding objects, with low-relief incised motifs (bands, discs/circular elements) covering the chest and abdomen \u2014 a fairly specific shared scheme rather than a generic 'human figure'. The clearest differences are in the density and character of the surface iconography: B carries elaborate incised bands, discs and hanging elements over the whole front and a headdress-like patterned band, while A is far plainer, with only a belt-like band and simple held object, and its head is more rounded and less framed.
